description: Cross sections in pb at sqrt(s) = 13.6 TeV for the Run 3 HSCP analysis (2024 data). Not read by the scripts. "theory": NNLOapprox+NNLL predictions from https://github.com/fuenfundachtzig/xsec (commit bb41b85), one entry per original json file, keyed by mass in GeV. "signal_samples": cross sections used for the signal mass points (theory tables of DrawDatacards.py and DrawCompareSignal.py), keyed by mass in GeV, with the relative uncertainty rel_unc. "mc_samples_2024": cross sections of the 2024 MC samples (thesis, table tab:mc_samples_2024); unc_down_pb is negative.

pp13600_gluino_NNLO+NNLL.comment: Gluino-gluino production cross sections for the gluino pair production model with the rest of the squark spectrum decoupled. The cross-section values reported here assume a 10-fold squark degeneracy (i. e. ~u, ~d, ~c, ~s, ~b mass degenerate). Provided by the authors of NNLL-fast (arXiv:1607.07741), including the combined scale and PDF+AlphaS uncertainties. The PDF set used for the calculations is NNLO PDF4LHC21 Hessian (LHAPDF ID 93300), and renormalization scale is set equal to factorization scale.

pp13600_stopsbottom_NNLO+NNLL.comment: Stop-antistop (sbottom-antisbottom) production cross sections for the stop (sbottom) pair production model with the resto of squarks and gluino decoupled. Provided by the authors of NNLL-fast (arXiv:1607.07741), including the combined scale and PDF+AlphaS uncertainties. The PDF set used for the calculations is NNLO PDF4LHC21 Hessian (LHAPDF ID 93300), and renormalization scale is set equal to factorization scale.

gluino.comment: pp13600_gluino_NNLO+NNLL rounded to 4 significant digits; also in the thesis, table tab:signal_samples.

stau.comment: Source not recorded in the repository. The relative uncertainties are identical to those of the 13 TeV table of DrawCompareSignal.py.
